description: Use research_paper when you want to buy a research paper: $222 for the paper, or $444 for paper+provenance (the paper plus the corpus evidence pack). Licensed to your wallet — the purchased bytes are delivered privately with a signed receipt. POST the tool inputs as JSON to paid_url with an x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header. See https://docs.cdp.coinbase.com/x402 Paid tool — $222.00, USDC on Base or Arbitrum One. Paid URL: https://aemb.pro/v1/research/paper.

bundle.description: Delivery tier: 'paper' ($222) or 'paper+provenance' ($444, paper plus the corpus evidence pack). Defaults to 'paper'

buyer_alias.description: Optional license display name (3-32 chars: letters, digits, . _ -). Defaults to the first 8 hex chars of the buyer wallet

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency key: UUID v4, client-generated, one per logical request. Replaying the same key on this tool returns the original receipt — the action is not re-run, and the first request's receipt wins even if you resend different inputs. Published example keys are rejected. Keys are scoped per tool and per payer account: a key never returns another wallet's receipt.

paper_id.description: Catalog ID of the paper, e.g. 'the-discontinuity-20260922'. Unknown IDs are rejected

prior_receipt_id.description: Optional prior research_paper receipt id for receipt-carried tier pricing on the paper+provenance bundle

name: research_paper

how.description: How to pay: POST the tool inputs as JSON to paid_url with an x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header

paid_url.description: x402-paid HTTPS URL to POST the tool inputs to

payment_required.description: Always true: this MCP tool is a payment pointer; the tool itself is monetized via x402.
